svg.title: PWA Profiles — Profile Stack identity
svg.desc: Canonical editable vector master. Built on a 512-unit grid with a 32-unit outer safe area. Active palette: continuity green #176B45, adaptive keyline #67C994, rear card #C8E8D5, front card #FFFFFF. Disabled palette: graphite #60656A, edge gray #AEB4B8, rear gray #C9CDD0, front gray #F4F5F5. All geometry is flat fill and stroke; no gradients, filters, raster images, text, or third-party marks.
svg.metadata: Grid: 512 × 512 units. Outer visible bounds: x/y 32–480 (6.25% safe area). Base: x/y 48, width/height 416, radius 96, 32-unit centered keyline. Rear card: x/y 96, width/height 256, radius 64; intentionally detail-free for 16px use. Front card: x/y 160, width/height 256, radius 64. Profile aperture: x 288, y 192, width/height 96, radius 32. 16px pixel cadence: 1px safe area/keyline, 2px card offset, 3px aperture.
